name: Example: create, inspect and delete a reference record through OData

data_service.about: Configured Ferry backend or separately provisioned Pond service for d365data; no tunnel alias is installed automatically

web_service.about: Configured d365web backend signed in to the same target with permission to view the reference form

company.about: Disposable legal entity with Asset management enabled

record_id.about: Fresh unused ZZTEST id, at most 20 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens; no apostrophes

requires: Documentation only: execute each part deliberately and inspect its result before continuing. Both services must target the same environment/company. The D365 data user needs create/read/delete on AssetMaintenanceJobGroups; the browser user needs the EntAssetJobGroup menu/form. Sourcecache 10.0.49: EntAssetMaintenanceJobGroupEntity is public and maps JobGroupId/Name to EntAssetJobGroup; EntAssetJobGroupID is 20 characters; the standard table has no delete actions. Check target metadata/extensions first. Stop unless the preflight query is empty; never delete a record that existed before this run.
changes: Creates and deletes only this run's unused reference-data id. Do not attach job types or other records to it. On any error, mismatch or lost reply, stop and inspect the exact id in the same company; clean up only after proving this run created it. Nothing runs this file automatically.

parts.note: Preflight: require shown=0, truncated=false and next=null. Otherwise stop and choose a fresh id.
Create the isolated reference record through its standard public entity. A lost response requires inspection before any retry.
Require exactly one row with this company, id and Name=ZZTEST OData example; stop on mismatch.
Readback in the standard reference form. JobGroup_JobGroupID is its source control name, independent of the localized caption. This UI example has not been run in the setup round.
Delete only the record proven to have been created by this run. Company supplies the dataAreaId key.
Final verification: require shown=0, truncated=false and next=null; otherwise record and investigate the residual.
